modelOverview: The RM 033 is Richard Mille's round-cased extra-flat automatic, a quieter alternative to the tonneau sports models. The RM 33-03 of 2025 succeeds the RM 33-02 with a new skeletonised Calibre RMXP3 driven by a platinum micro-rotor, a 41.7mm case just 9.7mm thick, and red gold numerals mounted on titanium rails above the movement.

RM 33-03.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre RMXP3 · skeletonised, off-centre monobloc platinum micro-rotor · 21,600vph · ~40h power reserve
RM 33-03.materials: Available in grade 5 titanium, or Carbon TPT with an 18k 5N red gold caseband
RM 33-03.dial: Skeletonised dial with 18k 5N red gold numerals mounted on titanium rails, small seconds at 6 o'clock and a semi-instantaneous date at 5 o'clock on a black PVD-treated titanium disc
RM 33-03.description: The RM 33-03 Automatic Winding brings Richard Mille's round case back into the current collection with a 9.7mm profile built around the new Calibre RMXP3, whose platinum micro-rotor keeps the movement to 3.28mm. The three-dimensional dial stacks red gold numerals on titanium rails over Titalyt and black PVD-treated bridges, in titanium or Carbon TPT and red gold. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Automatic Winding: The RM 33-03 as launched in 2025 — 41.7mm round case in titanium or Carbon TPT with red gold caseband, skeletonised Calibre RMXP3 with platinum micro-rotor, small seconds and date at 5 o'clock.
